related.title: Camunda BPMN：補償事件與部分完成流程
related.titleEn: Camunda BPMN: compensation and partially completed workflows
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 ledger.csv、沖銷鏈與科目分類差異。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver ledger.csv,reversal links and account-classification differences.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 記錄完成活動transport,hotel及補償執行，淨成本20；未完成第三步不產生虛假退款。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: Record completed transport/hotel and their compensations;net cost20 remains,and the incomplete third step produces no refund. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 1000-900-100 = 0 currency-units；對照 1000-800-200 = 0 currency-units。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
先按transaction_id與currency分組核對零差額；再核對收入/稅科目分類，證明兩組皆平衡但業務含義不同。

基準 120+200 = 320 credit-units；對照 (120-20)+200 = 300 credit-units。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
記錄完成活動transport,hotel及補償執行，淨成本20；未完成第三步不產生虛假退款。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline 1000-900-100 = 0 currency-units; comparison 1000-800-200 = 0 currency-units. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Group by transaction_id and currency to verify zero difference,then inspect account classification to show both balanced entries mean different things.

Baseline 120+200 = 320 credit-units; comparison (120-20)+200 = 300 credit-units. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Record completed transport/hotel and their compensations;net cost20 remains,and the incomplete third step produces no refund.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: POSIX fork/exec：程序樹與身分延續
related.titleEn: POSIX fork/exec: process trees and identity continuity
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 ledger.csv、沖銷鏈與科目分類差異。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver ledger.csv,reversal links and account-classification differences.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 建立事件、PID、PPID、映像、回傳路徑五欄表；區分父子 fork 回傳值與 exec 的成功／失敗。
related.differenceEn: Tabulate event, PID, PPID, image and return path, distinguishing fork’s two return paths from exec success/failure.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 1000-900-100 = 0 currency-units；對照 1000-800-200 = 0 currency-units。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
先按transaction_id與currency分組核對零差額；再核對收入/稅科目分類，證明兩組皆平衡但業務含義不同。

fork 建立子行程；exec 成功時替換目前行程映像而不另創 PID。只把成功 exec 後的程式碼視為不可達。
本課數值核對：1+3 = 4 processes；另一項核對：4+0 = 4 processes。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline 1000-900-100 = 0 currency-units; comparison 1000-800-200 = 0 currency-units. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Group by transaction_id and currency to verify zero difference,then inspect account classification to show both balanced entries mean different things.

fork creates a child; successful exec replaces the current process image without allocating another PID. Code after successful exec is unreachable.
Numeric audit: 1+3 = 4 processes; second audit: 4+0 = 4 processes. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
